meta.title: Buka Workflows
meta.description: Lets the workflow-orchestrator preset create and schedule a one-off workflow node graph at runtime: each robot keeps one session for the whole run; later entries compact that session's history (host compaction service) before sending the new prompt under the normal worker preset, without approval prompts, gate nodes wait for the normal approval dialog, gate-free runs keep advancing in the background, definitions may contain loops bounded by maxSteps and per-node maxVisits, and the run record, definition snapshot and node results are persisted for review. A read-only sidebar Workflows page draws each run as a git-log-like node graph: cross-row and loop edges use nested side lanes that never cross, every edge carries a mid-path arrow and each cycle reads as two opposite arrows between the same nodes, duplicate rules merge into one line, revisited nodes show ×N badges, and nodes the run never reached stay gray. Robot capsules also show that robot's preset avatar. Robot sessions are titled with the run goal and robot name, so the sidebar shows which run and robot a conversation belongs to; the detail panel shows the session id with an open-session action and marks repeated entries as history compacted; executions are split into tabs, each with its own rendered prompt, deliverable and session (the output shows the deliverable text only; routing fields are not dumped as key/value), and the bottom of a tab has previous / next links that walk the run in both directions. The end node shows the run's final deliverable.
